headlines.snippet: At least 15 tourists have died in Vietnam following a boat capsize. The vessel overturned off the island of Phu Quoc in the southern part of the country while returning from a trip. It was carrying 32 tourists and four crew members. headlines.snippet: Chaos erupted in Judea and Samaria as an American congressman was blocked by settlers, and a CNN crew was attacked. According to police, rioters punctured the tires of the media vehicle and were apprehended with a knife and a club. The congressman, identified as a potential presidential candidate in 2028, reported being blocked by armed settlers with M4 rifles in Hebron, who hurled insults and kicked his vehicle's tires. He claimed the individuals delayed them, and the IDF sided with them. The IDF stated that forces dispersed the civilians and allowed vehicles to proceed.

Hillel Biton Rosen bragged about this in a WhatsApp group with IDF spokespersons. headlines.snippet: For the second consecutive Saturday, confrontations occurred between worshippers and patrons of a Jerusalem café. Ultra-Orthodox individuals arrived to protest the opening of the "Bsimta" café on Shabbat, while dozens came to support the establishment. The protestors shouted "Shabbat Shalom," and those at the café responded with "Enlist!" Police, who were called to secure the location, dispersed the ultra-Orthodox demonstrators and also clashed with customers.

Following reports that Iran was plotting to assassinate him, Trump stated, "1,000 missiles are loaded and aimed at it." The attack occurred amidst a wave of settler violence across the occupied West Bank.
